text: Dalton is the clearest worked example of contractual discretion in this course: identify who has the choice, what process was promised, what facts bear on that choice, and how a remedy can enforce the process without dictating the result.
sourceSummary: ETS had to consider the relevant information it promised to consider, but the remedy was a good-faith reconsideration of the score rather than automatic certification of its validity.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
